pages.text: At the heart of the Fort waits the ruler who claims every camp, patrol, and buried vein of Bog Iron.$(br2)The Ogre King is not merely a larger Grunt. Expect royal commands, violent control of space, and defenders who still recognize his authority. Learn the fight by surviving it; this book will not list every surprise.
Defeating the King completes $(italic)Usurped$() and changes what the bog will surrender.
A fallen King leaves more than an empty chair.
